protests.name: CJP (Cockroach Janta Party) Jantar Mantar Sit-in
protests.location: Jantar Mantar, Central Delhi
protests.cause: Gen-Z-led movement demanding Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation over the NEET-UG paper leak scandal. Over 20 students died by suicide following the exam cancellation. Sonam Wangchuk joined with a 26-day hunger strike. The movement has spread nationwide and internationally.
protests.dangerReason: On July 20, police used tear gas, baton charges, and pellet guns against thousands marching toward Parliament. Multiple injuries reported. Mass detentions. Section 163 imposed across Central Delhi. Metro stations closed without notice. Medical access severely restricted.
protests.status: Extremely volatile but ongoing. Government agreed to talks at a neutral venue on July 24. Protesters remain at Jantar Mantar despite crackdowns. Tens of thousands defied police to march on July 20. Delhi University warned students to stay away from the area. Movement shows no signs of stopping.
details: Police presence: Heavy — Delhi Police + paramilitary battalions deployed
Recent incidents: Tear gas, pellet guns, baton charges (July 20), 40+ detentions
Medical access: Severely restricted — ambulances and medics blocked
Legal support: Multiple PILs filed including one challenging surveillance of protesters
Section 163: Imposed in Central Delhi, New Delhi, and Parliament areas
Metro: Rajiv Chowk, Patel Chowk, Central Secretariat may close without notice
